rawContent: July 4, 2019 marked 3 YEARS since #DelrawnSmall was murdered in cold blood by NYPD Officer Wayne Isaacs. We are demanding that @NYCMayor #FireWayneIsaacs, the NYPD officer that murdered Delrawn in front of his children and partner. #BlackLivesMatter

On July 2nd, we asked you to call Mayor DeBlasio and demand that he fire NYPD officer Wayne Isaacs immediately. TODAY, we're asking that you RT! @NYCMayor MUST #FireWayneIsaacs - the NYPD officer who murdered #DelrawnSmall and left him without aid! #BlackLivesMatter

#DelrawnSmall's family has been fighting for 3 years for discipline charges to be brought against the NYPD officer Wayne Isaacs who murdered Delrawn, lied about it & tried to cover it up. Today, we're demanding that @NYCMayor #FireWayneIsaacs immediately. #BlackLivesMatter
